title: Keyboard combination mapping to any of the Ctrl keys seems to fail

status.label: Covered by the active Copilot-key tracking issue
status.detail: This report is another Copilot-key-to-Ctrl remapping failure. The open #35808 discussion already tracks different emitted chords and partial failures and requests current-build confirmation of the exact source chord.

judgment.rationale: The issue reports that a Copilot key captured as Alt+Shift+F23 cannot be mapped to Ctrl. Open issue #35808 is the active tracking discussion for the same Copilot-key-to-Ctrl remapping behavior across devices; its current request explicitly asks contributors to provide the captured source chord and retest a shortcut-only mapping on a current build. This issue adds no distinct reproduction beyond a one-word confirmation and should not start a competing fix assessment.
evidence: The issue body lists PowerToys 0.91.1 and says the Copilot key is captured as Alt (Left)+Shift (Left)+F23, but mapping it to Ctrl does not work.
The reporter attached a PowerToys report archive and describes the laptop model and Windows build.
The only comment is 'Seconded'; it adds no separate reproduction or current-version confirmation.
Open #35808 tracks Copilot-key-to-Ctrl remapping failures and asks for current-build testing with the exact captured chord and a shortcut-only mapping.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep #35808 as the single tracking issue for this behavior; add no competing fix or duplicate request to #40196.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported behavior is already covered by open #35808, whose existing request asks for the exact captured chord and a current-build retest. This issue contributes no independent implementation path or distinct evidence that warrants a competing fix proposal.

issue_context.summary: A laptop's Copilot key is captured as Alt+Shift+F23, but mapping that shortcut to Ctrl does not work.
known_information: The issue lists PowerToys 0.91.1, Windows 11 Enterprise 24H2, and an HP Fury 16 G11.
The author says the Copilot key is captured as Alt (Left)+Shift (Left)+F23 and that mapping it to Ctrl fails.
The report includes a public PowerToys diagnostic archive and one 'Seconded' comment.
Open #35808 tracks the same Copilot-key-to-Ctrl behavior and asks for the exact captured chord and a current-build shortcut-only retest.
inferences: The Alt+Shift+F23 sequence may be an OEM-specific representation of the Copilot key, but the issue does not establish whether the same sequence still fails on a current build.
issue_context.analysis: The issue's captured chord is useful as another device-specific data point for #35808, whose unresolved reports include different Copilot-key sequences and partial modifier behavior. The canonical discussion already requests the exact source chord and current-build retest. Keep the report linked to that investigation rather than proposing a second fix or repeating the request.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body, its sole comment, labels, assignees, and linked diagnostic attachment metadata.
Read the current #35808 artifact and full 38-comment discussion; confirmed it already requests current-build testing and the exact captured chord.
Confirmed the issue remains open and unassigned, with no additional reproduction beyond the Copilot-to-Ctrl failure.
